newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares fall on political uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares fall on political uncertainty.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 1.69 percent on Tuesday as investors continued to huddle on the sidelines, waiting for the country's post-election political situation to become clearer.

"This is just a correction phase, which right now does not change foreign investors' positive view on Slovenia's economy," Fritz Schweiger, head of equity research at Investmentbank Austria in Vienna said.
The final official results from the general election on November 10 gave the ruling Liberal Democrats 25 seats in the 90-seat parliament.
The rightist "Spring" alliance comprising three parties received a total of 45 seats. Analysts expect prices to fall if the protectionist "Spring Parties" come to power.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 19.74 points to 1,145.6.
* Turnover rose to 110.9 million tolars from 78.4 million.
* Overall 11 shares fell, two rose and two were unchanged, while another nine were untraded. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
